name: @veren/baidu-pan-bundle
description: Use when a dsh profile should gain the whole Baidu Netdisk stack in one install: this configuration-only bundle inserts the server plugin row (@veren/baidu-pan, carrying the open-platform app triple) and the web panel row (@veren/baidu-pan-ui) in the order the runner needs, so nothing has to hand-edit cordis.patch.yml. Skip it when the profile composes those two loader rows itself.
